start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj perimeter seekhenge. Aapko maths mein kaunsa topic interesting lagta hai?

turns.line: samajh nahi aaya, ek example se samjhao
turns.reply: Jaise 6 m by 4 m vegetable patch ko fence karna ho: perimeter matlab chaaro sides ki total length. Aap total kaise nikaalenge?
Aapko cricket pasand hai—pitch ki boundary bhi perimeter jaisi hoti hai. Is baat par end mein lautenge. Ab har side jodkar perimeter nikaaliye: 6 plus 4 plus 6 plus 4?

turns.board: Rani runs 3 rounds of a rectangular park 50 m long and 30 m wide. How far does she run?
turns.reply: Koi baat nahi, Kabir. Chaar sides hain: 6 plus 4 plus 6 plus 4. Pehle 6 plus 4 kitna hoga?
